subject: RE: MMI + Encord - CS Syncs
text:
Hi Arisha,
Thank you for the message, we were not aware of this limit of the platform.
Andrea and I have aligned this morning and came up with this proposal:

  1.  In the project that is having issues “Microsurgical Step and Action Detection v2”, we propose to conclude the videos already started. The ones that cannot be concluded because they hit the storage limit, can be sent to review, annotating only the frames that are possible. We would just need to know a list of the videos that are not complete, such that we can adjust our agent and review for this.
  2.  Videos in “Microsurgical Step and Action Detection v2” that have not been started yet are moved back to the previous project “Microsurgical Step and Action Detection” (124b8c80-c925-4e65-a288-5495f42762d9). This project uses bounding boxes and not polygons, such that we don’t expect to hit limits there
  3.  We will update the ontology of project “Microsurgical Step and Action Detection”, to add two extra classes for the instrument polygons. We will ask to only annotate the instrument masks at a rate of 1 FPS, so not for all frames.

Do you think the approach could work? Could you support us in creating a list of tasks that should be moved from one project to the other? We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback.
In parallel, we’re also waiting for this weekly feedback on the annotation services use.
Thanks
Best, Elena

subject: Re: Invoices
text:
Hi Shivant,

Definitely worth a call as this was not my understanding, or reflective of our conversations in September. Firstly, it was never mentioned during our discussions in September that there was this additional invoice due, which I find surprising.

Secondly, having reviewed the invoices it is not clear that they are not duplicative. Invoice 1595  states:

  *
Encord Annotate (unlimited users, 500 videos included); and
  *
Encord Platform (additional 500 videos)

To me, this suggests that it covers access to the platform (for up to 500 videos) and an add on to top that up to 1,000 videos. I.e. both line items relate to platform access, the second simply a bolt on for additional volume.

Turning to invoice 1555, it contains a line item labelled "Encord Platform... 7,500 video bundle". This, to me, is also platform access, and therefore the same as invoice 1595. This was also my understanding during the conversations we had in September.

Best,
Charlie
